lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn4ZnO6 (reduced formula Zn5O6) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Zn centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (two O and two Zn). The analysis further finds corner- and edge-sharing between Zn octahedra and between O four-vertex polyhedra, with a three-dimensional connectivity component spanning all 20 sites.
